run_sat_collision_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation with SAT collision detection for concave URDF meshes
enable_sat_physics: enable SAT collision detection in pybullet by setting enableSAT=1 in physics engine parameters
load_urdf_with_sat: load a URDF model with SAT features initialized using the URDF_INITIALIZE_SAT_FEATURES flag
get_contact_points: get contact points between colliding bodies in the pybullet simulation using getContactPoints
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward in a loop while checking the connection status
